# PluginFieldsSelect

<!-- description:start -->
A dropdown select component for choosing Tracker fields inside a plugin. Accepts a flat list of fields with category metadata and automatically groups them into collapsible category sections. Supports search, multi-select, submit/reset actions, and loading states.
<!-- description:end -->

## Usage

```tsx
import {PluginFieldsSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {PluginFieldsSelectField} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

const fields: PluginFieldsSelectField[] = [
    {id: 'summary', name: 'Summary', category: {id: '1', display: 'System Fields'}},
    {id: 'description', name: 'Description', category: {id: '1', display: 'System Fields'}},
    {id: 'sprint', name: 'Sprint', category: {id: '2', display: 'Custom Fields'}},
];

<PluginFieldsSelect
    open={true}
    fields={fields}
    onOpenChange={(open) => console.log(open)}
    onItemSelect={(item) => console.log('selected', item)}
    onItemDeselect={(item) => console.log('deselected', item)}
/>;
```

## Component props

<!-- props:start -->
```ts
{
    /**
     * Flat list of fields to display. Each field must have an id, name, and category.
     * Fields without a category.id are silently excluded from the rendered groups.
     */
    fields: PluginFieldsSelectField[];

    /**
     * Whether the select popup is open.
     */
    open?: boolean;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the popup open state changes.
     */
    onOpenChange?: (open: boolean) => void;

    /**
     * Currently selected items. Used to render the "Selected" group and
     * to determine whether a click triggers onItemSelect or onItemDeselect.
     */
    selectedItems?: TrackerSelectItem[];

    /**
     * Whether the component is in a loading state. Shows a spinner instead of the list.
     * @default false
     */
    loading?: boolean;

    /**
     * Callback fired when an unselected item is clicked.
     */
    onItemSelect?: (item: TrackerSelectItem) => void;

    /**
     * Callback fired when a selected item is clicked.
     */
    onItemDeselect?: (item: TrackerSelectItem) => void;

    /**
     * Async callback fired when the submit button is clicked.
     * The popup closes automatically after the promise resolves.
     */
    onSubmit?: () => void | Promise<void>;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the reset button is clicked.
     */
    onReset?: () => void;

    /**
     * Callback fired when the search input value changes.
     */
    onSearchChange?: (search: string) => void;

    /**
     * Whether to show the search input inside the popup.
     * @default true
     */
    showSearch?: boolean;

    /**
     * Whether to show the submit button.
     * @default true
     */
    showSubmit?: boolean;

    /**
     * Whether to show the reset button.
     * @default false
     */
    showReset?: boolean;

    /**
     * Custom label for the submit button.
     */
    submitButtonText?: string;

    /**
     * Custom label for the reset button.
     */
    resetButtonText?: string;

    /**
     * When true, groups are expanded automatically when the user types in the search input.
     * @default false
     */
    expandGroupsOnSearch?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, the group with id === '1' (System Fields) is expanded by default.
     * @default false
     */
    expandSystemGroup?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, splits groups by their tag metadata and renders tag-filter buttons above the list.
     * @default false
     */
    splitDataByTag?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, renders tag-filter buttons above the list using group names.
     * @default false
     */
    withGroupTags?: boolean;

    /**
     * Custom footer content rendered below the item list.
     */
    footer?: ReactNode;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the root element.
     */
    className?: string;

    /**
     * Additional CSS class applied to the popup element.
     */
    popupClassName?: string;

    /**
     * IDs of items that should be rendered as disabled (non-clickable).
     */
    disabledItemsIds?: string[];

    /**
     * When true, shows a "Selected" group at the top of the list containing all currently selected items.
     * @default false (managed internally based on search state)
     */
    showSelectedGroup?: boolean;

    /**
     * Custom title for the "Selected" group header.
     */
    chosenGroupTitle?: string;

    /**
     * When true, hides the checkbox next to each item.
     * @default false
     */
    hideCheckbox?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, clicking an item closes the popup immediately (single-select mode).
     * @default false
     */
    singleSelect?: boolean;

    /**
     * When true, shows the item meta string below the item label.
     * @default false
     */
    showMeta?: boolean;

    /**
     * Custom render function for each item row.
     */
    renderItem?: (item: TrackerSelectItem) => ReactNode;

    /**
     * Custom render function for the info area of each item.
     */
    renderInfo?: (item: TrackerSelectItem) => ReactNode;
}
```

## Types

```ts
type PluginFieldsSelectField = {
    /** Unique field identifier, e.g. "summary" */
    id: string;
    /** Human-readable field name */
    name: string;
    /** Category this field belongs to. Fields without a category.id are excluded. */
    category: TrackerSelectItemValueBase;
} & Partial<Omit<Field, 'category' | 'name'>>;

type TrackerSelectItemValueBase = {
    id: string;
    display?: string;
};

type TrackerSelectItem = {
    id: string;
    display: string;
    category?: TrackerSelectItemValueBase;
    name?: string;
    system?: boolean;
    meta?: string;
    tags?: string[];
    required?: boolean;
    pinned?: boolean;
    type?: string;
};
```

---

## Tracker API

`PluginFieldsSelect` is data-agnostic — it accepts fields via the `fields` prop. You are responsible for fetching data from the Tracker API and passing it to the component.

Add the required permissions to your plugin's `manifest.json`:

```json
{
    "permissions": {
        "data": [
            "tracker:fields:read",
            "tracker:fields:write",
            "tracker:queues:read"
        ]
    }
}
```

- `tracker:fields:read` — required for `GET /fields` and `POST /fields/_suggest`
- `tracker:fields:write` — required if your plugin writes field values back to Tracker
- `tracker:queues:read` — required when using `localFields: true` with queue keys (Flow 3)

There are three fetch flows depending on whether the user has typed anything and whether local (queue-specific) fields are needed.

### Flow 1 — Initial load (no user input)

When the component mounts and no search text is present, fetch the full global field list:

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.get['/fields']();
return result.data; // PluginFieldsSelectField[]
```

> **Recommendation:** Fetch this list only once and store it in your component's initial state (e.g. in `useState` initialised inside a single `useEffect`). Avoid re-fetching on every render or every popup open.

### Flow 2 — Global field suggest (non-empty user input)

When the user types in the search filter and you only need global fields:

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/fields/_suggest']({
    bodyParams: {input: text, readOnly: true, localFields: false, extended: true},
});
return result.data; // PluginFieldsSelectField[]
```

> **Important:** The suggest endpoint returns an **empty response when `input` is empty**. Always guard against empty input before calling this endpoint, or fall back to Flow 1 data when the search is cleared.

### Flow 3 — Global + local field suggest for specific queues (non-empty user input)

When the user types and you also need queue-specific local fields:

```ts
const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/fields/_suggest']({
    bodyParams: {
        input: text,
        readOnly: true,
        localFields: true,
        extended: true,
        queues: ['QUEUEKEY'],
    },
});
return result.data; // PluginFieldsSelectField[]
```

> **Important:** The suggest endpoint returns an **empty response when `input` is empty**. Always guard against empty input before calling this endpoint, or fall back to Flow 1 data when the search is cleared.

> **Important:** When `localFields: true`, the `queues` array **must not be empty**. Sending `localFields: true` with an empty `queues` array will cause the request to fail. Always ensure at least one queue key is present before using this flow.

---

### Example 1 — Global fields, initial load only (Flow 1)

Loads all global fields once on mount and passes them directly to the component. No suggest is used — the built-in search input filters the already-loaded list client-side.

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {PluginFieldsSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {PluginFieldsSelectField, TrackerSelectItem} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi;
    onSubmit: (selected: TrackerSelectItem[]) => void;
}

export const GlobalFieldsSelect: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi, onSubmit}) => {
    const [fields, setFields] = useState<PluginFieldsSelectField[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<TrackerSelectItem[]>([]);

    // Flow 1 — fetch all global fields once on mount
    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .get['/fields']()
            .then((result) => setFields(result.data))
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    return (
        <PluginFieldsSelect
            open={open}
            fields={fields}
            loading={loading}
            selectedItems={selectedItems}
            onOpenChange={setOpen}
            onItemSelect={(item) => setSelectedItems((prev) => [...prev, item])}
            onItemDeselect={(item) =>
                setSelectedItems((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== item.id))
            }
            onSubmit={() => onSubmit(selectedItems)}
            expandSystemGroup
        />
    );
};
```

---

### Example 2 — Global field suggest on user input (Flow 2)

Uses Flow 1 to populate the initial list and switches to the suggest endpoint (Flow 2) as soon as the user types. The suggest response replaces the displayed fields while the user is searching.

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {PluginFieldsSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {PluginFieldsSelectField, TrackerSelectItem} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi;
    onSubmit: (selected: TrackerSelectItem[]) => void;
}

export const GlobalFieldsSelectWithSuggest: React.FC<Props> = ({trackerApi, onSubmit}) => {
    const [initialFields, setInitialFields] = useState<PluginFieldsSelectField[]>([]);
    const [fields, setFields] = useState<PluginFieldsSelectField[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<TrackerSelectItem[]>([]);

    // Flow 1 — fetch all global fields once on mount
    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .get['/fields']()
            .then((result) => {
                setInitialFields(result.data);
                setFields(result.data);
            })
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    // Flow 2 — suggest global fields when the user types
    const handleSearchChange = async (text: string) => {
        // Fall back to the initial list when the search is cleared —
        // the suggest endpoint returns empty results for an empty input.
        if (!text) {
            setFields(initialFields);
            return;
        }

        const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/fields/_suggest']({
            bodyParams: {input: text, readOnly: true, localFields: false, extended: true},
        });
        setFields(result.data);
    };

    return (
        <PluginFieldsSelect
            open={open}
            fields={fields}
            loading={loading}
            selectedItems={selectedItems}
            onOpenChange={setOpen}
            onSearchChange={handleSearchChange}
            onItemSelect={(item) => setSelectedItems((prev) => [...prev, item])}
            onItemDeselect={(item) =>
                setSelectedItems((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== item.id))
            }
            onSubmit={() => onSubmit(selectedItems)}
            expandGroupsOnSearch
        />
    );
};
```

---

### Example 3 — Global + local field suggest for specific queues (Flow 3)

Extends Flow 2 by including queue-specific local fields. Falls back to Flow 2 (global suggest, no local fields) when `queueKeys` is empty, because `localFields: true` with an empty `queues` array causes the request to fail. Falls back to the initial global list when the search input is empty.

```tsx
import React, {useEffect, useState} from 'react';
import {PluginFieldsSelect} from '@weavix/tracker-components';
import type {PluginFieldsSelectField, TrackerSelectItem} from '@weavix/tracker-components';

interface Props {
    trackerApi: TrackerApi;
    /** At least one queue key must be provided when using local fields. */
    queueKeys: string[];
    onSubmit: (selected: TrackerSelectItem[]) => void;
}

export const LocalFieldsSelectWithSuggest: React.FC<Props> = ({
    trackerApi,
    queueKeys,
    onSubmit,
}) => {
    const [initialFields, setInitialFields] = useState<PluginFieldsSelectField[]>([]);
    const [fields, setFields] = useState<PluginFieldsSelectField[]>([]);
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
    const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
    const [selectedItems, setSelectedItems] = useState<TrackerSelectItem[]>([]);

    // Flow 1 — fetch all global fields once on mount
    useEffect(() => {
        trackerApi.v3
            .get['/fields']()
            .then((result) => {
                setInitialFields(result.data);
                setFields(result.data);
            })
            .finally(() => setLoading(false));
    }, [trackerApi]);

    // Flow 3 — suggest global + local fields for specific queues when the user types.
    // Falls back to Flow 2 (global suggest only) when queueKeys is empty, because
    // localFields: true with an empty queues array causes the request to fail.
    const handleSearchChange = async (text: string) => {
        // Fall back to the initial list when the search is cleared —
        // the suggest endpoint returns empty results for an empty input.
        if (!text) {
            setFields(initialFields);
            return;
        }

        const hasQueues = queueKeys.length > 0;

        const result = await trackerApi.v3.post['/fields/_suggest']({
            bodyParams: {
                input: text,
                readOnly: true,
                // Use localFields only when we have at least one queue key.
                // With an empty queues array the request will fail, so we fall
                // back to Flow 2 (global suggest, localFields: false).
                localFields: hasQueues,
                extended: true,
                ...(hasQueues && {queues: queueKeys}),
            },
        });
        setFields(result.data);
    };

    return (
        <PluginFieldsSelect
            open={open}
            fields={fields}
            loading={loading}
            selectedItems={selectedItems}
            onOpenChange={setOpen}
            onSearchChange={handleSearchChange}
            onItemSelect={(item) => setSelectedItems((prev) => [...prev, item])}
            onItemDeselect={(item) =>
                setSelectedItems((prev) => prev.filter((s) => s.id !== item.id))
            }
            onSubmit={() => onSubmit(selectedItems)}
            expandGroupsOnSearch
        />
    );
};
```
